verdict.rationale: Guided Form 1583 completion is a fair question for a virtual mailbox (CMRA) service, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions Form 1583, pre-filled forms, online notarization, or ID requirements. Generic setup claims ("a few simple steps") and a complimentary onboarding session are adjacent features, not documented Form 1583 guidance.

support.subject: As a founder, I can complete USPS Form 1583 with guided help — pre-filled forms, online notarization, and clear ID requirements — instead of deciphering the CMRA process alone
